sources.title: ONNX Model Zoo - GitHub
sources.snippet: Welcome to the ONNX Model Zoo! The Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) is an open standard format created to represent machine learning models. Supported by a robust community of partners, ONNX defines a common set of operators and a common file format to enable AI developers to use models with a variety of frameworks, tools, runtimes, and compilers. sources.title: Track fundamental frequency and periodicity using CREPE (ONNX)
sources.snippet: The model file (tiny: ~2 MB, full: ~85 MB) is downloaded from the torchcrepe-onnx Hugging Face Hub repo on first use (requires the huggingfaceR package and a network connection) and cached in the R user directory; subsequent calls read the cached copy with no network access.
